en.sample_sheet_markdown:
# CF Clinic Visit Prep: Registered Clinical Trials and Questions for Your Care Team

This preparation sheet is an educational research summary, not medical advice. Please check this with your CF care team before changing anything. If a symptom is new, severe, getting worse fast or worrying, above all in a baby or child: Do not wait for me. Call your CF team's urgent or out-of-hours line, or local emergency services (911 in the US), now.

## 1. Privacy Reminder Before You Write Notes
Please do not write names, dates of birth, medical record numbers, or places on shared forms. Use general words such as 'my child' or 'about two weeks ago' rather than personal identifiers.

## 2. Top Three Open Questions to Ask Your CF Care Team
- Which clinical research options or registry studies make sense for us to discuss with our CF care team right now?
- When we look up the NCT identifiers listed below with our doctor on the official website, what do the study requirements involve for day-to-day care?
- What changes in breathing, digestion, or daily energy should we watch for and report before our next clinic visit?

## 3. Registered Studies Matching Your Selected Registry Filters [T1]
[T1] Source: ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 snapshot (snapshot date: 2026-10-14; deterministic filter: status=RECRUITING, modality=All modalities, phase=All phases, term=None). Listing on the registry does not evaluate safety or efficacy and does not denote government endorsement. I cannot tell you if anyone is eligible for a trial; only your CF care team and the study investigators can review official criteria. Please check each NCT record on the official website with your CF care team.

- **[T1] NCT06132048** — *A Usability Validation of the MuCopilot Mobile Application, a Digital Tool for the Unsupervised Objective Assessment of Cystic Fibrosis* | Registry status: `RECRUITING` | Phase: `NA` | Modality: `not stated` | Lead sponsor: Ad scientiam | Named interventions: MuCopilot mobile application | Registered primary outcome: Validation of usability (1) (time frame: 2 hours).
- **[T1] NCT02965326** — *Surrogate Markers of Response to New Therapies in Cystic Fibrosis Patients* | Registry status: `RECRUITING` | Phase: `NA` | Modality: `CFTR Modulator` | Lead sponsor: Hôpital Necker-Enfants Malades | Named interventions: Nasal swab; rectal biopsy. | Registered primary outcome: Forced Expiratory Volume in 1 second (time frame: initiation, 7 days, 1 month, 6 months, 1 year and every 6 months).
- **[T1] NCT05248230** — *4D-710 in Adult Patients With Cystic Fibrosis* | Registry status: `RECRUITING` | Phase: `PHASE2` | Modality: `AAV / Gene Therapy` | Lead sponsor: 4D Molecular Therapeutics | Named interventions: 4D-710 | Registered primary outcome: Incidence and severity of adverse events (time frame: 60 Months).
- **[T1] NCT04580368** — *Testing Drug Efficacy in Cystic Fibrosis Through N-of-1 Trials* | Registry status: `RECRUITING` | Phase: `NA` | Modality: `CFTR Modulator` | Lead sponsor: Children's Hospital Medical Center, Cincinnati | Named interventions: CFTR Modulators | Registered primary outcome: ppFEV1 (time frame: 16 weeks).
- **[T1] NCT07314229** — *Prevalence of Exercise-induced Ventilatory Limitation and Associated Factors in Patients With Cystic Fibrosis Receiving Elexacaftor-Tezacaftor-Ivacaftor* | Registry status: `RECRUITING` | Phase: `NA` | Modality: `CFTR Modulator` | Lead sponsor: University Hospital, Lille | Named interventions: Measurement of resistance through forced oscillations and continuous measurement of ventilation and inspiratory capacity during TM6 | Registered primary outcome: Estimate the prevalence of ventilatory limitation measured by a portable spirometer during a submaximal exercise test (6-minute walk test) in patients with cystic fibrosis undergoing ETI. (time frame: duration of 56 weeks starting in December 2025).

## 4. What to Bring to Your CF Clinic Visit
- Your top three questions written in your own words.
- Every medicine and airway-clearance device as actually used at home.
- Brief notes on what you noticed, since about when, and how often.
- Space to write down the answers from your CF doctor, nurse, pharmacist, or dietitian.

Please check this with your CF care team before changing anything. If anything on this list is new, getting worse, or worries you, call your care team now. Do not wait for the visit. This is not a diagnosis.

# Hoja de Preparación para Consulta de FQ: Ensayos Registrados y Preguntas para su Equipo Médico

Esta hoja informativa es una herramienta de preparación para su consulta y no constituye consejo médico ni diagnóstico. Si presenta un síntoma nuevo, grave, que empeora rápido o que le preocupa —especialmente en un bebé o niño—, no espere a la consulta: llame ahora a la línea de urgencias de su equipo de fibrosis quística (FQ) o a los servicios locales de emergencia (911 in the US).

## 1. Privacidad Antes de Escribir sus Notas
No anote nombres completos, fechas de nacimiento, números de expediente ni datos personales en herramientas en línea. Use palabras generales como "mi hijo" o "hace aproximadamente dos semanas".

## 2. Tres Preguntas Abiertas para Llevar a su Equipo de FQ
- ¿Qué opciones de estudio o seguimiento clínico se adaptan a nuestra situación actual según nuestro equipo de FQ?
- Si revisamos alguno de los identificadores NCT listados abajo en el sitio web oficial del registro, ¿qué significan sus criterios y qué implicaría participar para nuestra rutina diaria?
- ¿Qué cambios recientes en la respiración, la digestión o la energía debemos vigilar antes de la próxima visita?

## 3. Ensayos Clínicos Registrados que Coinciden con los Criterios de Búsqueda [T1]
[T1] Fuente verificada: Instantánea de ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 (fecha de corte: 2026-10-14, filtro determinista: estado=RECRUITING, modalidad=Todas las modalidades, fase=Todas las fases, término=Ninguno). Estar listado en el registro no significa que un estudio sea seguro, eficaz ni respaldado por el gobierno, y esta lista no evalúa si una persona cumple criterios de inclusión. Verifique cada código NCT en el sitio web oficial con su equipo de atención de FQ.

- **[T1] NCT06132048** — *A Usability Validation of the MuCopilot Mobile Application, a Digital Tool for the Unsupervised Objective Assessment of Cystic Fibrosis* | Estado en registro: `RECRUITING` | Fase: `NA` | Modalidad: `not stated` | Patrocinador principal: Ad scientiam | Intervenciones nombradas: MuCopilot mobile application | Desenlace primario registrado: Validation of usability (1) (marco temporal: 2 hours).
- **[T1] NCT02965326** — *Surrogate Markers of Response to New Therapies in Cystic Fibrosis Patients* | Estado en registro: `RECRUITING` | Fase: `NA` | Modalidad: `CFTR Modulator` | Patrocinador principal: Hôpital Necker-Enfants Malades | Intervenciones nombradas: Nasal swab; rectal biopsy. | Desenlace primario registrado: Forced Expiratory Volume in 1 second (marco temporal: initiation, 7 days, 1 month, 6 months, 1 year and every 6 months).
- **[T1] NCT05248230** — *4D-710 in Adult Patients With Cystic Fibrosis* | Estado en registro: `RECRUITING` | Fase: `PHASE2` | Modalidad: `AAV / Gene Therapy` | Patrocinador principal: 4D Molecular Therapeutics | Intervenciones nombradas: 4D-710 | Desenlace primario registrado: Incidence and severity of adverse events (marco temporal: 60 Months).
- **[T1] NCT04580368** — *Testing Drug Efficacy in Cystic Fibrosis Through N-of-1 Trials* | Estado en registro: `RECRUITING` | Fase: `NA` | Modalidad: `CFTR Modulator` | Patrocinador principal: Children's Hospital Medical Center, Cincinnati | Intervenciones nombradas: CFTR Modulators | Desenlace primario registrado: ppFEV1 (marco temporal: 16 weeks).
- **[T1] NCT07314229** — *Prevalence of Exercise-induced Ventilatory Limitation and Associated Factors in Patients With Cystic Fibrosis Receiving Elexacaftor-Tezacaftor-Ivacaftor* | Estado en registro: `RECRUITING` | Fase: `NA` | Modalidad: `CFTR Modulator` | Patrocinador principal: University Hospital, Lille | Intervenciones nombradas: Measurement of resistance through forced oscillations and continuous measurement of ventilation and inspiratory capacity during TM6 | Desenlace primario registrado: Estimate the prevalence of ventilatory limitation measured by a portable spirometer during a submaximal exercise test (6-minute walk test) in patients with cystic fibrosis undergoing ETI. (marco temporal: duration of 56 weeks starting in December 2025).

## 4. Qué Llevar a la Consulta de FQ
- Esta lista impresa con sus tres preguntas principales marcadas.
- Todos los medicamentos y dispositivos tal como se usan realmente en casa.
- Notas breves sobre cualquier cambio reciente (desde cuándo aproximadamente y con qué frecuencia).
- Si necesita traducción durante la consulta, solicite un intérprete médico calificado en su clínica.

Por favor consulte esto con su equipo de atención de FQ antes de cambiar cualquier tratamiento. Si algo en esta lista es nuevo, empeora o le preocupa, llame a su equipo de atención ahora; no espere a la consulta. Esto no es un diagnóstico.
